bug.description: checkout 显式传入 promo_percent=0 时，零优惠错误地变为默认优惠。

reproduction.expected: checkout([(50, 2)], promo_percent=0) returns 108; omitted promotion remains 97.2; 20% promotion remains 86.4.
reproduction.actual: test_explicit_zero_promotion fails: AssertionError: 97.2 != 108. Omitted promotion and 20% promotion tests pass.
